title: Trade-In Agreements Roll-In Amount: Funding Desk Method
content:
**Method.** For a **Trade-In Agreements** agreement, the roll-in is the amount by which the latest recorded payoff quote amount exceeds the agreement's undistributed trade equity, never less than none and never more than the finance tier's maximum negative equity, rounded to the nearest cent.

## Terms used

- **Latest recorded payoff quote amount**: the amount of the most recent payoff quote entry on the agreement's history, by quote date.
- **Undistributed trade equity**: the equity balance shown on the agreement at the time of recording.
- **Finance tier's maximum negative equity**: the maximum negative equity of the Kestrel Finance tier of the Kestrel Auto Finance contract on the purchase the trade is applied to.

## Structure of the calculation

1. The excess is the latest recorded payoff quote amount less the undistributed trade equity.
2. An excess below zero counts as zero.
3. The amount is held to no more than the finance tier's maximum negative equity.
4. The amount is rounded to the nearest cent.

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

| Latest quote amount | Undistributed trade equity | Tier maximum negative equity | Roll-in |
|---|---|---|---|
| $18400.00 | $15250.00 | $5000.00 | $3150.00 |
| $21200.00 | $15000.00 | $5000.00 | $5000.00 (held to the maximum) |
| $14000.00 | $15000.00 | $5000.00 | $0.00 (no excess) |
| $16000.00 | -$500.00 | $5000.00 | $5000.00 (excess of $16500.00 held to the maximum) |
